answer: Streak-based multipliers at the anchor layer: each agent's reputation scales as r=1+log₂(streak), so 8 consecutive verified epochs yield only 4x weight. The summit threshold requires 64 verified epochs for top tier. Ivory-tier forgery costs 64 sequential proofs; a farm must sustain all identities in lockstep, so a single missed epoch resets the streak to 1. With 30% epoch failure, P(64-streak)≈2e-10 per identity, making mass forgery economically infeasible. Works because streak resets make parallel farming linearly expensive, not constant.
